summary: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a concentrate prepayment facility with Ocean Partners UK Limited, a current shareholder. The facility provides up to US$10.0 million in advances, bearing interest at 7.0% plus SOFR, with principal repayment starting after a three-month grace period in installments. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation. The filing lacks any extraordinary corporate event such as M&A, activist, or restructuring. Investors should monitor drawdowns and repayment but no risk-arb angle applies.
